About this app

RHU Packet Tracer

This is the Course Ahead CCNA Labs app — free networking labs for everybody.

🧪 55 labs 🔓 First 20 labs open ⭐ Rest open free as you learn 💯 100% free forever 📴 Works offline 🧒 Kids Mode

💙 Why was this app built?

Good networking labs were locked. Students had to pay money to open them. Other practice apps were heavy and hard, so small students could not use them.

So this app was built for one big reason: every student — even a young kid — can practice real Cisco CCNA skills for free.

  • The first 20 labs are open for everyone, right away.
  • Finish them, and the next labs open one by one — like levels in a game. Still free. Always free.
  • No fees. No signup. No heavy software to install.
  • It works on your phone, your computer and the web — even without internet.
  • The words are super simple, and every step shows the exact command to type. Netro helps you all the way.

Nobody should be left behind because of money. Learning is for everyone.

🤞 Our promise: we NEVER charge for this app. A lock here only means “learn step by step” — never “pay money”.
